issues.on_page: Depreciation Fund, Building and sites: Supplies 234,551
issues.issue: The statement's 'Instructional support' 654,076 (p4) = General Fund 2200 lines 419,525 + exactly this 234,551, so the report counts these supplies as instructional support (Staff), not operation and maintenance of plant. The schedule's 'Building and sites' heading makes Building and Grounds defensible, but it doesn't tie to the statement function.
The statement's School administration 656,720 (p4) = 2410 514,424 + 2490 140,313 + this 1,983, so the report counts it as School Administration.
The statement's Central and business services 368,837 (p4) = 2500 lines 341,722 + this 27,115, so the report groups it under Business. Defensible as other support services.
